body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-06-22

# Summary
Warning-signs post for slab leaks in Arizona homes (warm floor spots, high water bills), with slab-on-grade, hard water, heat-driven pipe movement and expansive soil as the local angle. Published 2026-06-22 at `/blog/signs-of-a-slab-leak/` (ID 5827). The July brief names this file as the formatting reference for later drafts.

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: signs of a slab leak. SEO title (43 chars): "Signs of a Slab Leak: An Arizona Guide".
- Links: `/slab-leaks/` pillar, `/water-leak-detection/`, leak detection Chandler, leaking pipe repair, sibling hidden-leak post, contact. Reciprocal links to the PRV and multiple-fixtures posts held until live (21 and 26 Aug).
- External source: EPA WaterSense Fix a Leak Week (household leak statistic).
- The 2026-09-23 performance report lists `/slab-leaks/` among pages close to page one with no clicks (see [Summit AZ - Performance Report 2026-09-23](lib:brain-summit-az-performance-report-2026-09-23)).

- `.md`, `.html`, `_wp2\` and `_wp_new\` versions with banner and inline images.
